At the District 9 debate, candidates discussed how to allow permitted sidewalk vending while addressing unpermitted selling, including sales of stolen goods. Jaime Gutierrez and Julian Bermudez proposed a vendor-inclusive committee or commission; Bermudez emphasized self-policing and giving vendors more power. Roberto Hernandez called for residents, merchants, vendors, cultural groups and city departments to develop a plan. Stephen Torres and H. Brown supported designated vending spaces.
